meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能够控制浏览器，执行导航网页、填写表单、截图、提取数据、测试网站等操作。它会逐步编写小脚本完成任务，并保持页面状态。
howto.when: 当你要求访问网站、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、自动化测试或登录，或者使用“转到[网址]”、“点击”、“填写表单”等触发词时。

say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器并导航到百度。
Claude 会保存当前页面的截图。
Claude 会定位表单并填写提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, test web apps, and automate workflows. It writes small scripts to accomplish tasks incrementally while preserving page state.
howto.when_en: When you ask to visit a site, click, fill a form, screenshot, scrape, automate, test, or log in; or use trigger phrases like "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will launch the browser and navigate to Baidu.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page
say_en.note: Claude will save a screenshot of the current page.

say_en.text: Fill in the login form and submit
say_en.note: Claude will locate the form, fill it, and submit.
